scientific_integrity: Exact distinct set maps, not representing polynomials; classical Hasse Taylor and CRT are prior tools, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: For the equal-characteristic cubic truncated chain ring only. Broader near-ring and finite polynomial-function literature is not exhaustively accessible; no independent audit has been performed. Finite checks do not imply the infinite-family theorem.
title: Polynomial retraction images of cubic truncated local rings and the binary jet exception
